title: ExpenseAI - AI-Powered Expense Management
excerpt: A full-stack finance platform for expense tracking, budgets, savings goals, OCR receipt scanning, and AI-powered spending insights.
fullContent:
Developed a full-stack personal finance management platform that helps users track income and expenses, manage budgets and savings goals, visualize financial insights, and export reports.

Key Features

  • OCR-based receipt scanning for automated expense entry
  • OpenAI-powered personalized spending insights
  • JWT authentication and role-based access control
  • Monthly financial reporting and CSV data export

Tech Stack

React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma ORM

title: Weather Monitoring and Prediction System
excerpt: An IoT weather dashboard with live Firebase telemetry, environmental charts, trend forecasting, and prediction indices.
fullContent:
Built the responsive frontend for a first-year microcontroller-based IoT weather monitoring project.

Key Features

  • Live temperature, humidity, pressure, rain, and light telemetry
  • Firebase synchronization every 30 seconds
  • Interactive, toggleable Chart.js visualizations
  • Secondary environmental indices and weather trend forecasting

Tech Stack

JavaScript, Chart.js, Firebase, and IoT microcontrollers

title: Full-Stack Blog Application
excerpt: A fully functional full-stack blog application featuring secure authentication, CRUD operations, and a custom responsive UI.
fullContent:
Excited to share my latest project: a fully functional, full-stack Blog Application! 🚀

Building this from the ground up was an incredible learning experience. I wanted to challenge myself to not just build a frontend, but to create a complete, end-to-end solution.

💻 Tech Stack:

  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript
  • Backend: PHP (Custom REST API)
  • Database: MySQL

🔑 Key Features:

  • ✅ Secure user authentication (Login/Register with password hashing)
  • ✅ Full CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete blogs)
  • ✅ Strict authorization (users can only manage their own posts)
  • ✅ Integrated EasyMDE Markdown editor & Marked.js for dynamic rendering
  • ✅ Custom server-side caching for faster load times
  • ✅ Fully responsive, custom "Fashion & Design" UI

This project taught me so much about API routing, database security, handling live server deployments, and debugging environment configurations.

Check out the code on my GitHub here:
https://github.com/chathunikawiraj/Blog-Application.git

🌐 Live Demo:
https://fashion-design.infinityfreeapp.com/
